scope.purpose: Show where the current page sits in the site hierarchy, with a link to each ancestor.
useCases: Deep hierarchies in a back office (Projects / Acme / Settings / Members).
A long path collapsed behind an ellipsis menu (maxItems).
exclusions: Dropdowns on each level (sibling pages) in v1.
alternatives: A back Link when only the parent matters.
The page title alone for a flat site.

fixtures: Phosphor glyphs re-exported by examples/icon/glyphs.ts for the home icon example.

examples.preview: dist/previews/breadcrumb.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview breadcrumb)

contract.scope: Breadcrumb compound contract: label, size sm/md, separator chevron/slash, maxItems with a Menu of hidden items, moreLabel; child item (label, href, leading Icon); current page last.

decisionsTaken: Two sizes, sm (default, body.sm) and md (body.md): a breadcrumb sits above a page title and is usually small.
Ancestors in color.content.secondary, underlined and in color.content.primary on hover; the current page in color.content.primary, never a link, exposed as the current page.
Separators: chevron (default) or slash, in color.content.tertiary, decorative, mirrored in right-to-left text; intrinsic Phosphor glyph caret-right.
Collapse: maxItems keeps the first and the last maxItems - 1 items and puts the hidden ones in a Menu opened by an ellipsis IconButton (neutral ghost, breadcrumb's size); 0 never collapses.
When the line lacks room, labels shrink with an ellipsis, ancestors first; the full label stays the accessible name.
Link targets meet 44 px in the block dimension without changing the line (invisible extension).

Gate question 1 resolved (user, 2026-11-09: "ok pour tes 5 recommandations"): the shift along the viewport edge is fixed in lib/overlay for every overlay (Popover, Menu, Tooltip, Select, Combobox), with a browser test per overlay near the edge, presented at the implementation gate.

Svelte API: the items are an `items` array (label, href) with a `leading` snippet receiving the item and its index, instead of child components, so that the current page (last item) and the collapsed items are known during server rendering. The contract child item is unchanged. Recorded for the implementation gate.
The slash separator is drawn on the 256-unit grid (Phosphor has no slash glyph); the chevron is Phosphor caret-right.
nextAction: Wave 4 implementation gate: interactive review of the preview pages, then record the approval.
implementationNotes: Exports Breadcrumb and the BreadcrumbItem type.
An ancestor keeps 4em of label before its ellipsis; the full label is set as title when truncated.
